findings.body:
**Align the structured deferred-vendor tests with the source API.**

`deferredVendorErrorCodes` is not exported from `src/ops/dev/coderabbit.ts`, and `ParsedReviewerStream` has no `structuredEvents` field. `parseReviewerStream` derives `errorCodes` from `message`, so the vendor fixtures without messages produce empty codes rather than `rate_limited`. This test cannot execute successfully until the implementation and test contract align.
findings.title: Align the structured deferred-vendor tests with the source API.

findings.body:
**Map thrown errors to a `failed` result and keep `usageSummary`.**

`execute` opens a `try` at `src/ops/review/run.ts:173` that closes with `finally` at line 1130. It has no `catch`. An exception from the calls below therefore rejects the promise returned by `makeReviewRun`, and the caller gets no taxonomy result:

- `retainedReceiptFindings` at line 283 can throw. It calls `DeferredVendorDebtSchema.parse` on each persisted vendor-debt record (`src/ops/dev/internal/deferredLedger.ts:571`). A malformed record throws a `ZodError`.
- `readCurrentEnrollment` at line 1094 can throw. It throws on missing, conflicting, or cyclic predecessor lineage (`src/ops/dev/internal/deferredLedger.ts:303`, `305`, `306`). Corrupt persisted ledger state can trigger these throws.

The public op contract for `src/ops/**` requires a failure to map to the `failed` status. A rejection does not meet that requirement.

The usage loss applies to the second case. `runReview` pushes `observed.usageSummary` at line 715, before line 1094. If `readCurrentEnrollment` throws, the wrapper at lines 1134-1137 never reaches `foldKnownUsageSummaries`. Spend from that agent run is lost from the result.

Remedy: in the wrapper, catch errors from `await execute(input, usageSummaries)`. Return the `failed` variant of `ReviewRunCoreResult` (`src/ops/review/run.ts:108`) with the error message. Use the field shape of that failed variant. Then fold `usageSummaries` after the catch so recorded spend is kept.
findings.title: Map thrown errors to a `failed` result and keep `usageSummary`.
